feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 June 2026 5:44pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 05 June 2026 at 5:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the southwest of Ireland bringing a frontal trough over the area tonight.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 in the west, backing southeast 5 or 6, occasionally 7 overnight. Decreasing 4 or 5 late morning tomorrow, then 3 or 4 early afternoon before falling variable for a time. Settling west or southwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate occasionally rough overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain or drizzle overnight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 to 6, backing south or southwest Sunday morning, increasing 6 or 7 for a time Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Patchy outbreaks of rain in places, becoming more persistent later Sunday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
